method: Human inspection of beginning, middle and end frames for every current workflow, plus important tap/transition contact sheets for the principal booking, service, no-show and saved-result flows. Every real tap timing and all text bounds were separately checked by script.
notClaimed: Every second watched in realtime; physical iPhone/Instagram overlay testing; production availability.
notes: Navigation loading waits were cut while retaining actual taps and settled results. Some early opening shots still show a brief data-card refresh in the real dashboard.
Setup disclosure was moved below the brand tagline to avoid overlap.
Inactive catalog footage and service-level approval footage were archived; current approval uses working salon-wide rules.
No-show customer review uses a real requested/suspended state; the synthetic management view also displays a financial-review notice for its intentionally incomplete older fixture.
The stopped fifth no-show rehearsal was corrected through the existing authorized API, preserving its audit trail.
